lead: Hand-drawn 2D gothic anime in the style of Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust (2000, Madhouse, Yoshiaki Kawajiri): a cel animation frame with fine thin black ink outlines, flat cel shading with hard-edged shadows, elegant long faces, painted gothic backgrounds, cold moonlight, a blue-black and violet palette.
take: Hand-drawn 2D gothic anime, Bloodlust cel animation
decision: 2026-10-13 chain test only, not a ruling
